name: 48314 · Sterling Hts, MI
findings: ZIP 48314 (Sterling Hts) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48314 (Sterling Hts) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48314 (Sterling Hts) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 36% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
